evals.prompt: A slice passed all sensors. Distill the learnings from the session trace into a skill.
evals.expected_output: Trace extracted from .do-harness/agent_state.db, a generalized heuristic with project-specific identifiers stripped, and an updated or new skill in .agents/skills/ with evals/evals.json, evaluated with a PASS/NEEDS_WORK/FAIL verdict and evidence.
assertions: The heuristic is generalized and evidence-based

evals.prompt: cargo clippy fired three times this sprint on the same pattern. What should we do?
evals.expected_output: Steering-loop action: treat >2 sensor fires in a sprint as a signal, update the matching feedforward guide (AGENTS.md or the relevant skill) instead of patching symptoms, and if no guide exists create one via the distillation steps.
